traits.name: Dictates Tempo
traits.desc: Increases the chances of the player taking charge predominantly in midfield situations and using their attributes to influence the team’s performance and pace.

traits.name: Curls Ball
traits.desc: Improves the player’s ability to curl the ball above and beyond his ability as already determined by his attributes.

traits.name: Tries Tricks
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player displaying more flair during matches and can result in a greater array of skills being used.

traits.name: Uses Outside of Foot
traits.desc: Increases the likelihood of a player trying to use the outside of his stronger foot rather than his weaker foot, even if the weaker foot is the more natural option for his body position.

traits.name: Brings Ball Out of Defense
traits.desc: Increases the likelihood of a defender running with the ball into midfield positions.

traits.name: Dives Into Tackles
traits.desc: Increases the frequency with which a player will engage in a tackle. It does not simply mean the player goes to ground when challenging for the ball.

traits.name: Does Not Dive Into Tackles
traits.desc: Decreases the frequency with which a player will engage into a tackle. It does not simply mean the player stays on his feet when challenging for the ball.

traits.name: Marks Opponent Tightly
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player being successful when asked to adopt tight marking, but his overall success is still controlled by his full set of attributes.

traits.name: Crosses Early
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player crossing from a deeper position, rather than seeking to find a better opportunity higher up the pitch.

traits.name: Likes to Switch Ball to Other Flank
traits.desc: Increases the frequency of a player looking to move the ball from one side of the pitch to the other.

traits.name: Looks for Pass Rather than Attempting to Score
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player opting to give a scoring chance to a team-mate rather than take it on himself. The success of the decision will be based off the player’s attributes.

traits.name: Plays One-Two's
traits.desc: Increases the frequency with which a player will make a pass and immediately want to receive the ball again, having moved into an advantageous position.

traits.name: Tries Killer Balls Often
traits.desc: Increases the frequency with which a player will attempt through balls.

traits.name: Tries Long Range Passes
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player attempting to pass the ball over longer distances.

traits.name: Knocks Ball Past Opponents
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player looking to beet his immediate opponent for sheer pace and athleticism to get into a more advantageous position.

traits.name: Likes to Beat Opponent Repeatedly
traits.desc: Increases the likelihood of a player opting to dribble with the ball regardless of how many opponents are positioned to try to dispossess him.

traits.name: Runs With Ball Often
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player choosing to run with the ball rather than pass it.

traits.name: Runs With Ball Rarely
traits.desc: Decreases the chances of a player choosing to run with the ball instead looking to make a pass at every turn.

traits.name: Tries to Play Way Out of Trouble
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player looking to pass or dribble against pressure in a defensive position, rather than opting for the safety-first approach of clearing the ball.

traits.name: Attempts Overhead Kicks
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player attempting a spectacular overhead kick rather than a header at goal or to a team-mate when in an attacking position.

traits.name: Likes to Lob Keeper
traits.desc: Increases the likelihood of a player looking to lift the ball over the goalkeeper when presented with a chance at goal.

traits.name: Likes to Round Keeper
traits.desc: Increases the likelihood of a player looking to go around the goalkeeper in one-on-one situations.

traits.name: Places Shots
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player opting to place his shots with accuracy rather than power them.

traits.name: Shoots From Distance
traits.desc: Increases the frequency with which a player will attempt shots from outside the penalty area.

traits.name: Shoots With Power
traits.desc: Increases the chances of a player opting to shoot with power over placement. It also increases the likelihood of a player attempting long-range shots, particularly where his Flair is better than his decisions.

traits.name: Tries First Time Shots
traits.desc: Increases the likelihood of a player taking a shot before considering a touch to settle himself, unless he’s one-on-one, at which point he will take the best course of action for that situation.

traits.name: Arrives Late in Opponent's Area
traits.desc: Increases the frequency with which a player makes forward runs, adjusting for team mentality.

traits.name: Comes Deep to Get Ball
traits.desc: Increases the frequency of a forward player dropping into midfield to get possession against a team playing with a deep defensive line.

traits.name: Cuts Inside from Both Wings
traits.desc: Increases the frequency with which a player will to attack central areas from a nominal wider starting position.

traits.name: Gets Forward Whenever Possible
traits.desc: Increases the frequency with which a player makes forward runs, adjusting for team mentality.

traits.name: Gets into Opposition Area
traits.desc: Mostly governs how often a player makes forward runs but the frequency can also be affected by player tactical instructions.

traits.name: Hugs Line
traits.desc: Ensures the player will remain in wide areas of the pitch whenever possible.

traits.name: Likes to Try to Beat Offside Trap
traits.desc: Increases the frequency with which a player will look to make runs in behind the defense. The success is determined by his other attributes.

traits.name: Moves into Channels
traits.desc: Increases the frequency with which central players will move into the space between their position and a wide attacking position. It also allows wide players in certain roles to move inside into that space.

traits.name: Plays With Back to Goal
traits.desc: Player will look to hold up the ball in attacking areas.

traits.name: Stays Back at All Times
traits.desc: Player will make no forward runs, adjusted for team mentality.
